We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What were looking for We are looking to expand our team with a highly motivated, innovative and results-oriented Full Stack Developer that will help us set an efficient, powerful and highly available system while also keeping an eye on best practices, clean code and enrolling of newcomers. The project manages and monitors fleets of SIMs on behalf of multiple countries, with millions of records to track, follow and interrogate and is part of a larger context that involves teams from Romania and France, all working together in an Agile manner. The backend is mostly based on technologies such as Java, Spring, Sql, Hibernate, Docker, Kubernetes, while the frontend is written in Vue. Who you are: . You are an experienced application developer passionate about latest technologies.. You are able to work comfortably in a fast-changing environment on interesting technical challenges. You have a passion for efficiency, performance and continuous improvement. You enjoy growing and integrating team members and proactively support their continuous improvement What youll be doing Execute user interface designs from product requirements or UX specifications from Figma. Collaborate with backend developers to create a scalable, standardized and flexible UI architecture. Ship high-quality, elegant, well-tested, secure and clean code Ensure software is up-to-date with latest technologies . Participate in design discussions about new features and make sure they can be reliably integrated Active participation in backlog grooming, sprint planning and implementation. Own and manage different phases of the software development lifecycle: coding, testing and debugging new complex software solutions What you need to know/have 3+ years of experience with full-stack development, including understanding UI frameworks and back-end architecture interactions. Professional experience with frontend technologies: VueJS 2+, Vuex, HTML 5, JavaScript/Typescript, CSS, SASS. experience using Java frameworks - Spring (Spring Boot, Spring container, Spring MVC, Spring Integration, Hibernate) in developing highly available distributed systems Good understanding of RDBMS Experience developing Webservices (REST / SOAP). Good understanding of REST APIs and HTTP communication. Experience with front-end tooling (npm-scripts/Webpack). Comfortable using version control (Git). Good communication skills (we enjoy chatting :D) Nice to have: .Experience in writing reusable components .Familiarity with monitoring and observability patterns and tools . Experience in working within an international agile team (Scrum) . Previous practice with continuous integration systems (CI/CD)Whats in it for you: Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys; Electronic Meal Tickets Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too; #WFH & Flexible hours; Professional GSM subscription; Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]; Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services; Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring; Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen; Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology. Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development. At Orange, you can. IMPORTANT In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered. We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
